translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: では改めてさいならー」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「ち、ちかれたー！」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Haa haa...

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「You guys, what the hell was that fight!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Rushing forward sloppily, no caution around you!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: fight with a bit more composure.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「う……はーい……」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Uu... Yesss...」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: your fighting has also gotten sloppy.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「自覚がないとは言わせないぞ。

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Hah, don't lump me in with you!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Even so, I'm still stronger than the rest of them!」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「なら、尚更だ！
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Then all the more reason!

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I'm telling you to calm down!」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Haaah!?」
「...Again?」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「あたしも賛成。

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and sat down on the spot.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Without Reset-san,

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: are those two always like this?」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「No, not to this extent...

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: They feel they have to save Reset...」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: so it's hard to tell what's going on...」
